title: OperatorRecord
description: Worker registry operator record (§C.4). Describes who offers worker services, which trigger types they handle, on what networks, and under what terms. Orbital is the registry and verification layer - not the guarantor of anyone's execution. No field in this record asserts or implies an Orbital guarantee of execution.

stellarAddress.description: Operator's Stellar account address (G…) for on-chain identity.

contact.description: Contact email or URL for the operator.

maintainer.description: GitHub handle or other identifier for the operator maintainer.

items.description: The class of trigger a worker service responds to.

latencyTier.description: Self-declared latency tier. Operators self-declare; this is not verified by Orbital.

version.description: Semantic version of this record. Increments on any change.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this record was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent update.

OperatorTerms.description: Structured service terms offered by an operator. Comparable across operators because they are data, not prose.

pricePerInvocation.description: Price per invocation in the specified denomination.

dailyCap.description: Maximum number of invocations per day, or 0 for unlimited.

slaMs.description: SLA response time in milliseconds, or 0 if no SLA is offered.
